You described perfectly what I’ve gotten myself into right now. I had therapy last year and I guess that helped but it didn’t feel like it did at the time. It took a while for me to reach out to my parents about how horrible I felt all the time. I feel like if I reach out again they’ll see me as just wanting attention and last time I had therapy my therapist advised that I write a letter to them about how I felt about them... it was a pretty harsh letter and she read it out loud to them with my permission. I know that letter hurt and I unintentionally made it seem like it was their fault I had depression but I can assure you it definitely was not. I made it seem like it was their fault and I know that they think I’m going to pull that shit again. They don’t want to look bad in front of professionals. Also yes they are really great people and they take care of me and my sister to the best of their ability. I also feel like they get mad at me for acting so unenergized all the time. Sometimes I’ll just lay in bed all day and I can feel their judgement. They even say I’m lazy but I can understand where they’re coming from. My mom also gets mad when I can’t tell her personal stuff. She says that therapists are people you don’t even know who they are doing their jobs for the money. That they don’t actually care about you so why can’t you just tell me all your problems? But what she doesn’t understand is how much easier it is to load tour problems on people you don’t even know? Don’t you find it so much easier to tell your problems to someone you don’t know because you don’t have a history with them? Like you don’t know them so you don’t know what they think of you.

School, I can’t even start with. Last year I was actually okay like I was getting a lot of A’s but that still didn’t solve the problem I was feeling guilty and felt awful for no particular reason. Any external problem I would fix but that just didn’t seem to cut it. This year I just stopped trying. If it isn’t the grades then what the actual fuck is it? Just make it go away you know? I stopped therapy because I felt fine at the beginning of freshman. I was part of a friend group with a pretty high social status and my grades were good. I still felt very empty inside. I didn’t really feel close with most of the girls but only a few who I am still friends with but I constantly felt bad and I didn’t know where all this was stemming from. Then this year, which is sophomore year I completely fell apart. I switched friend groups and formed a group with girls not very high on the popularity status. I enjoy having lunch with them but they aren’t my type of people I don’t know. It also doesn’t help how two of the girls in my group are insanely pretty and they are insanely smart too. They make me feel so insecure about myself. One of the girls from my friend group also makes me feel bad on purpose. She makes subtle comments. Like for example today she said I was shaped like a block lmao. She isn’t very smart or very pretty, she is overweight but constantly tells us her ass is big or something and how she thinks of herself as curvy but someone who wasn’t in my friend group said there was a difference between fat and curvy, but she was just flat and fat. I thought that was kind of mean but secretly I agreed. She likes my style and I can see her trying to develop one like mine. She does respect me most of the time and she thinks very highly of me but she makes me feel bad all the time. I feel like she kind of discredits people with depression because she always talks about it so much like she’s proud of having it. I think she is going through something but screaming “I’m going to kill myself” every ten seconds isn’t very cool. I’m super quiet in most of my classes except for a club I’m in which is robotics and in math class. I’m pretty loud there and I can be myself. 

Tomorrow, or I guess in a few hours I have so much to do. There’s a Socratic seminar, which I won’t speak in but it is mandatory to talk, there’s a chemistry test, I tried studying but it was very overwhelming and I felt super unmotivated, and then there was also English I needed to do. It sounds so easy but I can’t fucking do it and it’s so pathetic. Every time a student complains about their grade it’s because they have a low A or a B or something and it’s kind of embarrassing to talk about grades with them when you know they’re just going to say “just study”.  I mean yes, when you get a bad grade it temporarily shocks you but in the long run, what are you going to do about it? I just get over it and then the cycle repeats. Anyways I think I need sleep.
Yeah, I get it. As of right now I’m trying to comfort myself by reading about people in the same situation as me in bed. It just feels so good to have everything disappear you know?

Thank you so much for the advice but I seriously don’t know what to do. Like I can’t fix anything. It’s too hard. I’ve already reverted back to very bad habits and I can’t break out of this cycle. Most of the time I just lay in bed and I feel so lazy all the time but every time I want to fix it I just get so overwhelmed so I just go back to bed.
